description: Validate a package.json "exports" field: flag common dual-package (ESM/CJS) misconfigurations — a "types" condition not listed first, a missing "default" fallback, a "require"/"import" pointing at the wrong file extension, mixing subpath and condition keys in the same object, and a subpath pattern with no matching "*" in its target.

text.description: The full package.json file contents (only the "exports" field is read)

name: validate_package_exports
